local.headline: Council backs $4M in utility help; judge closes National Guard lawsuit
body: Action News 5 reported that the Memphis City Council approved $4 million in utility assistance while discussion of MLGW's proposed rate increase continues.
FOX13 Memphis and WBBJ reported that the lawsuit challenging the National Guard's deployment to Memphis is now closed.

sources.title: Council approves utility aid as MLGW rate talks go on
Lawsuit over Guard deployment in Memphis is closed
Judge closes suit over Guard presence in Memphis

state.headline: Broderick wins U.S. House seat; state House Democrats pick Love as leader
body: The Chattanooga Times Free Press reported that Democrat Victoria Broderick won a Tennessee seat in the U.S. House, ousting Rep. Scott DesJarlais. Tennessee Lookout reported earlier that DesJarlais had conceded the 4th Congressional District race. Tennessee Lookout also reported that Democrats in the state House chose Harold Love as their new minority leader and kept Clemmons as chair.
WSMV reported that rain arriving Wednesday is expected to complicate holiday travel, with snow showers possible on Thanksgiving.

sources.title: Broderick wins House seat over DesJarlais
State House Democrats choose new leaders
Rain and snow showers may affect holiday travel

federal.headline: Army detonation in Iowa set to proceed; jury convicts Huawei
body: ABC News reported that the Army said its planned detonation of lead explosives in Iowa would go ahead after an appeals court denied a bid to stop it. CBS News reported that officials set the detonation for Wednesday morning. According to ABC News, Iowa's governor issued an emergency proclamation covering three counties.

PBS NewsHour and ABC News reported that a U.S. jury found Chinese tech company Huawei guilty of charges that include conspiracy to steal trade secrets and bank fraud. ABC News put the number of counts at 10.

sources.title: Army says Iowa detonation will go ahead
Officials set Wednesday morning for Iowa detonation
Iowa governor issues proclamation ahead of detonation
Jury finds Huawei guilty in federal trial

international.headline: Riyadh drone strike reported; UN chief presses for Colombia peace deal
body: Al Jazeera reported that Saudi civil defense said 11 people were injured in a Houthi drone attack on a tower in Riyadh. The outlet later reported that the Saudi-led coalition intercepted Houthi attacks following a strike on Hodeidah in Yemen. Separately, ABC News reported that President Trump said the Iran war is "funded" through January.
UN News reported that Secretary-General António Guterres urged renewed commitment to Colombia's landmark peace agreement.

sources.title: Saudi officials report injuries in Riyadh drone attack
Live updates on Iran and war funding
Guterres speaks on Colombia peace deal
